popSources.EUR: 1000 Genomes phase 3 European superpopulation (via Ensembl REST, release 116, fetched 2026-08-13)
popSources.EAS: 1000 Genomes phase 3 East Asian superpopulation (via Ensembl REST, release 116, fetched 2026-08-13)
popSources.SAS: 1000 Genomes phase 3 South Asian superpopulation (via Ensembl REST, release 116, fetched 2026-08-13)

popSources.MID: gnomAD v4 genomes, Middle Eastern (modest reference sample size — supporting evidence, not a primary call)

popSources.FIN: 1000 Genomes phase 3 FIN — Finnish in Finland (via Ensembl REST, release 116)

popSources.NFE: gnomAD v4 genomes, Non-Finnish European (used only as the ASJ likelihood-ratio baseline)

provenance.frequencyConvention: every value is the ALT-allele frequency for the stated ref/alt pair
sourceSummary: 1000 Genomes phase 3 via Ensembl REST (https://rest.ensembl.org/variation/homo_sapiens?pops=1 (batch POST, 200 ids/call)), release 116, fetched 2026-08-13
gnomAD v4 genomes (https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api GraphQL, dataset gnomad_r4, genome AFs (ac/an per population)), fetched 2026-08-13
notes: Pruned at build time from the 43-column staging panel to the 12 population columns the offline AdmixtureEngine consumes; frequencies rounded to 4 decimals.
NWE is the mean of 1000G CEU and GBR alt-allele frequencies.
Within-EUR informative subset (eur flag): |dAF| > 0.1 on any of NWE-vs-S-Europe, FIN-vs-NWE, IBS-vs-TSI, ASJ-vs-NFE; 885 markers after LD dedup.
ASJ founder subset (asj flag): |ASJ-NFE| > 0.1; 377 markers pre-dedup, 375 after LD dedup.
LCT-region LD cluster rs4988235/rs182549/rs6754311: subset flags kept only on rs182549 so one haplotype cannot dominate the within-EUR or ASJ likelihoods.
398 palindromic (A/T or C/G) markers are shipped but are dropped by the engine at match time — strand orientation is never guessable for them from array data.
This panel ships inside the app bundle; the app performs zero network access.
